description: Fix triage dashboard error and add sidebar navigation. Three issues: (1) Add 'Triage' entry to sidebar navigation with children (Overview, Paths, Profiles), (2) Remove the erroneous triageBatch({}) call in the dashboard that causes a 400 error on load, (3) Add a 'Run Triage' section to the dashboard so users can trigger triage from the UI.
steps: In ui/src/app/layout/sidebar/sidebar.component.ts, add a Triage nav item to the allNavItems array (after SBOM, before Teams). It should have route '/triage', icon (use a medical/analysis icon like a clipboard or microscope emoji), and children: [{label: 'Overview', route: '/triage/overview', icon: appropriate}, {label: 'Paths', route: '/triage/paths', icon: appropriate}, {label: 'Profiles', route: '/triage/profiles', icon: appropriate}].

In ui/src/app/pages/triage/triage-dashboard.component.ts, remove the triageBatch({}) call from loadData(). The dashboard should only call getDashboardSummary() and listProfiles() on init. Results should start as an empty array and only be populated when the user explicitly runs triage.

In the same dashboard component, add a 'Run Triage' section in the template between the meta info section and the results table. This section should include: (1) A project selector dropdown (populated from SbomService.listProjects()), (2) A profile selector (already have this), (3) A 'Run Triage' button that calls triageService.getProjectTriage(selectedProjectId, {profile: selectedProfile}). The results should be mapped into the existing results signal. Show a loading indicator during the triage run.
Import SbomService in the dashboard component. Add a signal for projects (SBOMProject[]), a signal for selectedProjectId, and load the project list on init.

Ensure the loading state transitions are correct: loading starts true, set to false after getDashboardSummary completes (not after triageBatch). The results table shows 'No triage results' empty state until user triggers a run.
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /triage no longer produces a console 400 error or JS error
The sidebar shows a 'Triage' entry with expandable children (Overview, Paths, Profiles)
The dashboard displays summary cards and a Run Triage form
Clicking 'Run Triage' with a selected project calls the correct API endpoint and displays results in the table
The Angular build completes without errors: `pnpm --prefix ui run build`
verification: Run `pnpm --prefix ui run build` and confirm it succeeds with no errors
findings: Tests are pre-existing failures (TestBed.initTestEnvironment not called in spec files) unrelated to this change. Build passes cleanly. The pnpm test script has a version mismatch issue that deletes node_modules - running vitest directly on the base branch shows the same 15 test file failures.
